title: LLM-IDEA: Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent for Autonomous Discovery of Mechanistic World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.11253v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model agents are being increasingly deployed as autonomous scientists, designing experiments and inferring mechanistic world models with minimal human oversight. Yet identifiability is often overlooked: when a plateau is reached, the agent needs to know whether it is not yet capable enough or the model simply is not identifiable from the data, in which case no amount of further experimentation of the same kind can help. We propose the Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent (LLM-IDEA) for closed-loop discovery with an identifiability engine that returns a three-way plateau verdict: capability limit, resolvable within the design class, or certified exhausted. On ODEBench, 60 of the 62 systems with free constants are identifiable at round 0; the RC circuit is certified exhausted for every experiment that protocol can run, and a harvesting model is resolvable by one added initial condition. translated_title: LLM-IDEA：面向机制性世界模型自主发现的可辨识性驱动实验智能体
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型智能体正日益被部署为自主科学家，在极少人类监督下设计实验并推断机制性世界模型。然而，可辨识性问题往往被忽视：当达到平台期时，智能体需要判断究竟是自己能力尚且不足，还是该模型根本无法从数据中被辨识——若是后者，再多同类型的实验也无济于事。我们提出了可辨识性驱动的实验智能体（LLM-IDEA），用于闭环科学发现，其内置的可辨识性引擎可对平台期给出三方判定：能力极限、在设计类别内可解决、或已被认证穷尽。在ODEBench基准上，62个含自由常数的系统中有60个在第0轮即可辨识；其中RC电路被认证为该协议所能运行的任何实验均已穷尽（无法进一步辨识），而一个收获模型只需增加一个初始条件即可解决。该可辨识性引擎能够……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LLM-IDEA智能体，将可辨识性分析引擎引入基于大语言模型的闭环科学发现，使智能体在实验平台期能准确区分“能力不足”、“可通过新增实验设计解决”与“模型本质不可辨识”三种情况，从而避免无意义的重复实验。
